sportsbook.potentialWinLimit.description: Potential Win Limit defines the maximum total potential win a Member can accumulate from Sportsbook bets. Bets will be denied if this limit is exceeded.
sportsbook.potentialWinLimit.appliesTo: Applies to: All Sports, All Bet Types under Sportsbook
sportsbook.potentialWinLimit.excludes: Excludes: Parlay Bets (Mix Parlay, System Parlay, Combo Parlay, Single Match Parlay) - excluded during this phase

calculationLogic.title: Calculation Logic
calculationLogic.accumulated: Accumulated Potential Win = Sum of all running (unsettled) tickets + settled tickets (settled after limit set)

trackingStart.title: When Does Tracking Start?
trackingStart.accumulation: Accumulation starts from the moment the Agent sets a specific Potential Win Limit.
trackingStart.included: Only running tickets at that moment and settled tickets after that point are included.
trackingStart.example-ticketB: Ticket B (Settled at 1:50 PM) -> Not counted

resetBehavior.title: Reset Behavior
resetBehavior.dailyReset: Daily Auto Reset = YES by default (12:00 PM GMT+8): Clears all settled tickets.
resetBehavior.manualReset: Manual Reset (via Transfer): Clears settled tickets at the time of transfer.
resetBehavior.runningTickets: Running tickets are never cleared and always count toward the limit.

resultAmendment.title: Result Amendment Impact
resultAmendment.recalculation: Amending a settled ticket (e.g., WIN -> DRAW) will recalculate the accumulated win.
resultAmendment.example-after: After Amendment: Settled Win = 0 -> Total = 4,000 -> Unblocked

importantNotes.title: Important Notes for Agents
importantNotes.defaultLimit: Members have Unlimited Potential Win Limit by default
importantNotes.defaultReset: Daily Auto Reset = YES by default
importantNotes.appliesTo: Applies only to Sportsbook (not Live & RNG Casino or RNG Games)
importantNotes.management: Limit can be managed in Member Account Page and Potential Win Limit Page
